name: VORTE PRO
description: VORTE PRO WhatsApp Bot — deployable to Heroku and other Node.js hosting panels

OWNER_1.description: Primary owner's WhatsApp number, with country code, no + or spaces (e.g. 255700000000)

SESSION_ID.description: Paste your VORTE_PRO~ session ID here (generate it via the pairing site first)

SESSION_FOLDER.description: Local session storage path (leave default unless you know you need to change it)

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key, for .gpt and image-style commands (optional)

RAPIDAPI_KEY.description: RapidAPI key, for .randommovie/.randomtv and other RapidAPI-backed commands (optional)

PORT.description: Port for the built-in web server (Heroku sets this automatically)
